players.product: NovaSeq sequencing, BioInsight, and Billion Cell Atlas multi-omics data

quarterly_data.signal: Illumina introduced three early-access capabilities on its BioInsight Platform at ASHG: BioInsight Platform Workflow Orchestrator (connects to Illumina sequencers to run sample tracking, sequencer run planning, secondary analysis, quality control and tertiary analysis as one process across tens of thousands of samples), DRAGEN Ultra (variant prioritization with Illumina genomic AI models, available on the platform and on customer premises, private clouds and air-gapped environments, and to include the new dnaAI variant-prioritization model) and BioInsight Platform Learning Cohorts. Company-reported early research findings: applying dnaAI to large-scale datasets gave an 8% increase in disease associations across unsolved cases, and it ranked previously established disease-associated variants among its top four candidates in 99.4% of genomes analyzed.
quarterly_data.figure: dnaAI: 8% increase in disease associations; established variants among top four candidates in 99.4% of genomes analyzed
